edge_comparison.edge_definition: minimum distance to an image boundary <= 10% of that axis pixel span

interpretation.215934: Eight image-to-image correspondences checked against prior blind external solution; hypotheses were engine-guided, so this is not blind verification. Four anchors and four withheld registration points.
interpretation.source10: Tycho-2 candidate assigned a neighboring star; blind HYG-based Astrometry solution selects kappa Dra. HYG is shared with Starglyph, so this is an algorithm cross-check rather than independent catalog accuracy.
interpretation.edges: Sparse outer-10%-strip correspondences, not full perimeter coverage.
